name: smwgraphics-super-r-type-resource-acquisition-area
title: Super R-Type - Resource Acquisition Area
description:
The background seen in the fifth stage of Super R-Type. Reripped from scratch. Compared to the old submission, this version has better palette allocation, in general, and the colors are easier to remap. A good fit for mechanical bases or industrial areas.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
